decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures, while also controlling the board with spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. It utilizes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Disciple of Freyalise to accelerate mana production and plays big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to finish the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful control spells, taking advantage of Eldrazi synergies to dominate the battlefield.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with high-powered creatures like Atraxa and Griselbrand, then use cards like Goryo's Vengeance to cheat them into play for a powerful combo finish. Cards like Quantum Riddler and Psychic Frog can help with card selection and control, while Ephemerate and Solitude provide protection and removal. The strategy revolves around reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard at instant speed to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful board presence by utilizing creatures that can generate mana or tutor for other creatures. The goal is to ramp up mana quickly using Leyline of Abundance and Green Sun's Zenith, while also utilizing creature toolbox cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Fiend Artisan to search for specific creatures needed for the combo. The deck also includes a finisher in Craterhoof Behemoth and protection in cards like Ouroboroid and Walking Ballista. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently searching for and playing key creatures to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Nethergoyf, as well as powerful threats like Emperor of Bones and Thought-Knot Seer. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga provides additional card advantage and utility. Overall, the deck focuses on combining efficient disruption with a fast clock to overwhelm opponents.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of creatures and spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It includes efficient removal spells, powerful creatures such as Ragavan and Kroxa, as well as Leylines to boost their effectiveness. The deck aims to quickly establish a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's plans while applying pressure to win the game swiftly. It uses a combination of multicolored lands and cards to ensure versatility and consistency in its plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of colors to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By incorporating cards that provide extra value or benefits based on the number of colors in play, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to consistently apply pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, while using removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the battlefield and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful instant speed reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Griselbrand from the graveyard to the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Solitude for protection or removal, as well as Thoughtseize for disruption. The deck aims to set up explosive combos and control the game with a mix of threats and answers, creating powerful turns and overwhelming the opponent with strong creatures and disruptive plays.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while gradually gaining card advantage and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats. The deck also includes a few key combo pieces like Isochron Scepter and Consult the Star Charts to generate card advantage and lock opponents out of the game. Overall, the deck's strategy is to control the board, draw cards, and eventually win the game through superior card advantage and powerful threats.

This Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, aiming to deal damage as quickly as possible to the opponent. Utilizing efficient and direct burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Rift Bolt, along with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Chandra's Incinerator punishes opponents for playing spells, further adding pressure to the board.

The main idea of this deck is to use Song of Creation along with various mana accelerators and card draw engines to quickly generate a huge amount of value and win the game in one explosive turn. By chaining together free spells, card draw effects, and powerful combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive burst of card advantage and mana advantage, ultimately leading to a game-winning play. The deck focuses on setting up the right pieces to maximize the potential of Song of Creation and execute its combo strategy efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to use the synergy between Broodscale Bloodchief and various other cards to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Malevolent Rumble, Basking Broodscale, and Writhing Chrysalis, the deck aims to generate massive amounts of value and disruption to control the game. This combo-based strategy, supported by Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, allows the player to quickly build a formidable board presence and achieve victory through overwhelming force.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creature deployment and efficient removal spells. It emphasizes a fast and proactive gameplay style, using cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure early on. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while Goblin Bombardment adds reach and versatility. The deck's mana base is optimized for speed and consistency, allowing it to consistently apply pressure and control the pace of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Amulet of Vigor to generate mana quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift. The deck aims to assemble the Amulet Titan combo by using ramp spells and land tutors to power out powerful threats and overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes key utility lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further support the combo strategy and protect against disruption from opponents.

This deck revolves around utilizing Song of Creation to draw through your deck quickly and assemble the necessary pieces for a combo win. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Amber help with ramping and generating value, while Engineered Explosives and Mishra's Bauble offer control and card advantage. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps with card selection. The goal is to set up a winning board state using the cards drawn from Song of Creation while being able to protect yourself with various control pieces.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressively playing low-cost creatures and utilizing powerful support cards to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The range of cards allows for flexibility in dealing with different types of threats and maintaining pressure throughout the game. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and capitalize on its aggression to secure victory before the opponent can mount a successful defense.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with key creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones using cards like Thought Scour and Faithless Looting. It then utilizes cards like Persist and Unearth to bring these creatures back from the graveyard to the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. The deck includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game and protect the combo. The strategy revolves around reanimating powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.
